## Course Details
- Course Name: Privacy and Security in Online Social Media (PSOSM)
- Course Code: noc26-cs69
- Instructor: Prof. Ponnurangam Kumaraguru (PK)
- Institutions: IIIT Delhi, IIT Madras, SWAYAM / NPTEL
- Coverage: 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026 assignment questions (512 total)

## Curriculum & Weekly Topics
- Week 1: Introduction to OSM, Real-world Incidents, Ubuntu, Git, Python, Anonymous Networks (Whisper, Sarahah).
- Week 2: OSM APIs, Reddit API, Facebook Graph API, Data Collection, Trust & Credibility, JSON.
- Week 3: Misinformation, Fake News Detection, Flair NLP, Twitter API v2, MongoDB, SQL.
- Week 4: Privacy & Pictures on OSM, k-Anonymity, l-Diversity, t-Closeness, Linking Attacks, Exif Metadata.
- Week 5: Policing Online Social Media, Sentiment Analysis, VADER, LIWC (Linguistic Inquiry and Word Count).
- Week 6: eCrime on OSM, Phishing, Whaling, Spear Phishing, Scams, Social Network Analysis (SNA).
- Week 7: Link Farming, Sybil Attacks, Spamdexing, Privacy Nudges, NLTK Text Processing.
- Week 8: Geospatial Privacy, Location-Based Social Networks (LBSN), Check-in Dynamics.
- Week 9: Spatial Privacy, Highcharts, Foursquare, Mobility Traces.
- Week 10: Inferring Home Location, Username Change Dynamics, Crisis Informatics, Boston Marathon Misinformation Case Study.
- Week 11: Course Synthesis, Revision, Exam Pattern Analysis, Privacy Policies.

## Platform Features
- 512 machine-audited questions with verified NPTEL accepted answers.
- Conceptual explanations with week-level course mapping.
- 12 weeks of high-yield revision notes and exam cheat sheets.
- Graded practice exam mode with real-time server scoring.
- 360-page printable reference PDF for offline study.
- Complete mobile-responsive design.
